post_processing.step: re-embed base-color texture at 1024x1024 for the Web budget (orchestrator follow-up, 2026-09-18)
tools: python3 struct/json GLB rewrite (project-local, no pygltflib)
commands: python3: extract images[0] bufferView bytes (JPEG 2048x2048, 3179442 B, sha256 b75094c5f8ec28971ab9890e4d63b8cda7d860a3ba6c00b43545c90a351e19de) -> evidence_desk_texture_2048.jpg

python3: rewrite GLB = header + JSON chunk (same accessors/meshes/nodes/materials/textures; bufferViews[4].byteLength=201579; buffers[0].byteLength=514468; images[0].mimeType image/jpeg) + BIN chunk (original geometry bytes 0..312888 unchanged, then the new JPEG, 1 zero pad byte)
post_processing.alternative_rejected: PNG re-encode at 1024x1024 measured 1476141 B, larger than JPEG q85; JPEG kept
post_processing.geometry_check: BIN bytes 0..312888 (index/position/uv/normal bufferViews) byte-identical; accessor min/max identical; 4794 triangles / 7980 vertices; single node identity matrix unchanged
post_processing.engine_check: godot --headless --script on disposable copy: DESK-LOAD err=0 meshes=1 images=1 tex=(1024,1024) aabb=[P:(-0.648643,-0.950109,-0.430104) S:(1.29525,1.898466,0.855582)] tris=4794; smoke 8/8 hash 4b2310173dc059071fdc98e7705608d383dda81559706c3dd33bc96983108892

limitations: Presentation-only prop; never enters canonical state, save data, symbolic evaluation, or primary research evidence.
Optional at runtime: SealedLighthouseWorldBuilder.attach_model returns null when the file is absent and the procedural desk remains the complete build.
The requested 6000-triangle target produced 4794 measured triangles.
Parsed with a project-local struct/JSON check only (magic, chunk lengths, accessor min/max); engine load is verified by lane C on a disposable copy.
The GLB-embedded texture is not extracted as a separate runtime PNG; the GLB is loaded through GLTFDocument at runtime.

PBR generation disabled for the Web budget; one opaque double-sided material carries the embedded base color, re-encoded to a 1024x1024 JPEG (quality 85, 201579 B) from the 2048x2048 original (3179442 B); the higher-resolution source is not retained in the tree.
Editor import extracts the embedded JPEG as evidence_desk_0.jpg (201579 bytes) beside the GLB; see import_side_products.

import_side_products.produced_by: godot --headless --import (Godot 4.7.1 scene importer default gltf/embedded_image_handling=1 extracts the embedded image beside the source GLB; same behavior as the D-050 player lane's higgsfield-player_texture_0.png)

import_side_products.note: Not needed by SealedLighthouseWorldBuilder.load_model_scene, which reads the GLB through GLTFDocument at runtime; whether to track the extracted JPEG and its .import is an orchestrator decision at import time.
